en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a tall, rectangular medieval tower with a crenellated top, standing alone in an open square with a few adjacent low buildings and distant hills. In the upper left corner there is a circular emblem with the colors of the Italian flag (green, white, red) and a small black eagle-like symbol. At the bottom center, printed text reads the location and name of the tower.
